A PRAYERLESS CHRISTIAN.

September 27 at 11:24 AM 2 min read Latunde Akin

A PRAYERLESS CHRISTIAN.
(By Latunde Akin)
A prayerless christian is a crooked christian.
A spiritual criminal,a backslider,and already made to be engulfed and swallowed by hell.
Prayer is a direct holy rebellion against devil.And in that respect if the devil tag you a rebel.Won't that be good?
Our theology minus 'KNEEOLOGY' is no threat to the enemy of our soul.
That you cannot pray more than you talk is a sign that you're a corrupted saint.Already in Satan's cage.Ready to be slaughtered like chicken.
By your prayerlessness,you're more useful for Satan in God's camp than Satan's own agents in his camp.
Do you get addicted to watching cable TV,films,internet until those gadgets begin to watch you in return?
Why not return to your knees(your first love)today?
Do you know a crooked christian shall not make heaven?
Christian seek ye not repose....in the midst of foes you are.Watch and Pray.
Many lives God wanted to transform by your prayers are still getting wasted day by day.
Even your present lack is because of this same prayerlessness.
Why not ask God to release upon you afresh your passion to pray?
Or is it work schedule hindering you?
But you can sleep without hinderance?
God must rescue spiritual lukewarm people today if they will repent.
Right now,recieve your lost spiritual strenght back in Jesus name.
Redundancy begone!Amen.
